About Us
Hedera To Earn (HTE) is an all-in-one gateway to
Hedera’s digital economy, enabling users to
earn from everyday actions like missions, games, and
shopping. Built on the fast, secure, and carbon-
negative Hedera network, HTE connects real-use
DAPPs into one seamless platform with a shared
reward system. Each DAPP retains its native
token, but users earn in a single interoperable
token — $HTE — for flexible use across the ecosystem.
One platform, many ways to earn.
HTE Ecosystem
Projects
The Hedera To Earn (HTE) platform will launch with four core DAPPs—each offering a unique way to earn from real-world activity. These projects form the foundation of the HTE ecosystem, which will soon expand into new sectors like Finance, Trade, Study, Research, and Code to unlock broader utility across a unified platform.
Cashtree ($CTT)
Mission to Earn
Cashtree is Indonesia’s leading Mission-to-Earn platform with over 30 million users since 2015. Users complete missions, watch ads, and earn Cashtree Tokens ($CTT). As part of HTE, Cashtree bridges Web2 audiences into Web3 with real utility and rewards.

HTE Token
Utility
The $HTE token is the backbone of the Hedera To Earn platform, serving as a unified
reward and transaction standard across all integrated DAPPs.
Unified Conversion Token
$HTE acts as the single destination token for all rewards earned from DAPPs like $CTT, $MRST, and $BERRY.
Users convert DAPP-specific tokens into $HTE, simplifying their overall experience.
Cross-
DAPP
Usage
Whether you’re playing games, completing missions, or shopping in-app, $HTE can be used across all partner applications — as a payment, reward, or unlock mechanism
Centralized Reward Distribution
All user activity within the ecosystem is ultimately rewarded in $HTE.
This standardization improves clarity, reward tracking, and wallet management.
Token
Swap
Infrastructure
$HTE streamlines token flow by acting as the final conversion token.
Each DAPP retains its native token, but users only need $HTE to interact across the ecosystem.
Governance & Staking (Coming Soon)
In future updates, $HTE will introduce staking and governance — enabling users to participate in key ecosystem decisions and earn staking rewards.

Roadmap
Phase 1:
Foundation Launch
(2025 H1)
  • Official launch of the HTE platform
  • Blade Wallet integration
  • Launch of DAPPs: Cashtree, MRST, and Berry Store
  • One-way conversion live for DAPP tokens → $HTE
  • 40 Million Users
Phase 2:
Ecosystem Expansion
(2026 H1)
  • Launch of Developer SDK / Partner Portal
  • More partner DAPPs onboarded
  • Launch of NFT marketplace and reward-based NFTs
  • Enhanced mission system and cross-app reward mechanics
  • Whitepaper v2 and token utility expansion
  • 60 Million Users
Phase 3:
Dev & Community Scale
(2026 H2)
  • New earning models (Finance2Earn, Code2Earn, Study2Earn, etc.)
  • Integration with third-party Web3 platforms
  • Expansion of reward distribution models
  • Initial governance participation using $HTE
  • Social growth layer release
Phase 4:
Full Ecosystem Integration
(2026 H2 - Future)
  • DAO Framework for ecosystem governance
  • Cross-chain compatibility exploration
  • HTE Marketplace fully launched
  • Advanced analytics dashboard for users & partners
  • 100M users onboarded across all DAPPs
